topic: Zoro's Conqueror's Haki came from a cursed blade demanding everything, not from a Haki lesson like Luffy's
title: Zoro's Haki Came From A Sword, Not A Teacher
description: Luffy got a Haki course on Rusukaina, but Zoro's Conqueror's Haki came out under pressure from Enma, Oden's sword. One fan analysis says Mihawk never taught Haki directly, and chapter 1193 shows Zoro still working on control. Full breakdown in the long video linked above.
comment: Did Zoro get his Conqueror's Haki from Mihawk's training, or was it always his own to find? Pick a side.

lines.text: Zoro never learned Haki the way Luffy did, and that's the whole point.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman with a glowing black sword

lines.text: Luffy spent two years on Rusukaina with Rayleigh drilling all three types.

shot.fallback: anime style, young pirate training on a rough island

lines.text: Zoro spent two years with Mihawk, learning the blade first.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman practicing at dawn

lines.text: Armament Haki came from that training, but one fan analysis says Mihawk never taught Haki directly.

shot.fallback: anime style, sword glowing with armored energy

lines.text: His Conqueror's Haki didn't come from a lesson at all.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman with aura bursting out

lines.text: It came from Enma, Oden's sword, which drains the Haki of whoever holds it.

shot.fallback: anime style, cursed black katana with dark energy

lines.text: It demanded that Zoro stop holding back, so he let it all out.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman with aura pouring off a blade

lines.text: Then chapter 1193 showed the cost: Sommers noticed his Haki wasn't always on the blade.

shot.fallback: anime style, armored knight watching a swordsman

lines.text: Luffy got a map. Zoro got a fight he had to learn from mid-swing.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman mid-swing against a knight

lines.text: My read: Zoro's Haki isn't weaker, it's harder to hold.

shot.fallback: anime style, swordsman focused on a glowing sword

lines.text: Luffy got the teacher, and Zoro got a blade that wanted everything, which is why

shot.fallback: anime style, black blade glowing in the dark

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Zoro and sets up the Luffy contrast within two seconds.
self_check.loop: The last line ends on 'which is why' and flows straight back into line 1's 'Zoro never learned Haki the way Luffy did'.
